findings.message: The poll loop has no exception handling, so any Databricks API failure that outlives the retry policy (auth expiry, a 404 after the warehouse is deleted, a persistent 5xx) escapes `run()` as a raw traceback from the triggerer instead of a structured event. Wrap the call and yield an `{"status": "error", ...}` event like the other triggers in this module, and add the matching branch to `execute_complete` — right now an error status would fall through to the "unexpected status" message.
